原文：You're probably using a custom font! 
 Unity's got a bug where custom fonts have their size set to 0 by default and there's no way to change that! So to avoid this error, here's a solution: 
 * Drag any font into Unity. Set it to be 'Unicode' or 'ASCII' in the inspector, depending on the characters you want your font to have. 
 * Set 'Font Size' to whatever size you want 'quality' to be locked at. 
 * Click the gear in the corner of the inspector and 'Create Editable Copy'. 
 * Now, under the array of 'Character Rects', change size to 0 to clear everything. 
 * Now you have a brand new font to edit that has a font size that's not zero! Yeah!
译文：您可能正在使用自定义字体！
Unity存在一个漏洞，即自定义字体的默认大小被设置为0，且无法更改此设置。为了避免出现这种错误，以下是解决方法：
* 将任何字体拖入Unity中。在检查器中选择“Unicode”或“ASCII”模式，具体取决于您希望字体包含哪些字符。
* 将“字体大小”设置为您想要的大小，并将“质量”选项锁定为某个值。
* 点击检查器角落中的齿轮图标，选择“创建可编辑副本”。
* 现在，在“字符矩形”数组中，将大小设置为0以清除所有内容。
* 这样，您就拥有了一个全新的、字体大小不为0的字体了！就是这样！
